post.description: Forget the cached schema; the next completion or search rebuilds it.

get.description: Never called; exposes the WebSocket protocol models in OpenAPI.

post.description: What the safety policy would say about each statement if the user had not confirmed it yet.

AppSettings.title: AppSettings
AppSettings.description:
The app preferences (`settings.json`). Persisted, so a newer build's extra fields are tolerated on read and
kept on write; input from the API stays strict.

ConfirmationRequiredEvent.title: ConfirmationRequiredEvent
ConfirmationRequiredEvent.description: The statement was not run: resend it with `confirmed=true` once the user agreed. `finished(skipped)` follows.

DangerReason.title: DangerReason
DangerReason.description: Why a statement is dangerous: the standard safety level asks before running it.

Dialect.title: Dialect
Dialect.description: The SQL dialect of an engine: how its statements are split, classified, completed and quoted.

ExecutionSchema.title: ExecutionSchema
ExecutionSchema.description: Exposes the WebSocket protocol in OpenAPI so the frontend types are generated.

ExportCommand.title: ExportCommand
ExportCommand.description: Run `sql` again on this session and write its whole result, as raw values, to the file at `path`.

GuardReason.title: GuardReason
GuardReason.description:
Why the safety policy asks for confirmation (a danger, or any non-read statement at the strict level) or blocks
a statement (a read-only connection). Every `DangerReason` is one, with the same value.

ProfileSecretsInput.title: ProfileSecretsInput
ProfileSecretsInput.description: `None` keeps the stored secret; an empty string clears it.

ProgressEvent.title: ProgressEvent
ProgressEvent.description: An export has written `rows` rows so far; sent after every 10,000 rows.

SessionStateEvent.title: SessionStateEvent
SessionStateEvent.description:
The session's transaction state: sent right before every `finished` and every pause, on attach and after an
idle rollback.

WorkspaceState.title: WorkspaceState
WorkspaceState.description: The open tabs (`workspace.json`), written whole every few seconds so that a crash loses nothing.
